_comment: Constants for the AEM Edge Delivery cloud config node, taken from the real exported package. confRoot + the {site} folder mirror the content tree; 'repo' on the config becomes the full EDS site name. ref/edgeHost/owner/projectType can be overridden per environment in environments.json via aemRef/aemEdgeHost/aemOwner/aemProjectType.
title: Edge Delivery Service Configuration
